2607.01131.title: Autonomous Scientific Discovery via Iterative Meta-Reflection
2607.01131.paper_summary: Autonomous scientific discovery systems offer the potential to accelerate research by automating the process of hypothesis generation and validation. However, current systems operate within constrained search spaces or require predefined research questions, limiting their capacity for true open-ended inquiry. Furthermore, while they generate hypotheses iteratively, they largely lack the ability to explicitly synthesize their own accumulated findings to uncover complex, interconnected phenomena. We introduce DiscoPER, an autonomous large language model-powered framework that conducts open-ended research by dynamically generating and executing code to explore datasets without pre-specified research objectives. To ensure rigorous scientific validity, every proposed discovery must pass statistical testing. To overcome the limitations of isolated search, our framework introduces a second-order reasoning mechanism that periodically analyzes its own accumulated discoveries. By treating prior discoveries as empirical data, DiscoPER identifies structural patterns, confounds, and epistemic gaps, actively redirecting hypothesis exploration toward uncharted regions of the search space. The search space is further expanded by incorporating tool use, enabling the system to explore hypotheses beyond structured metadata by seamlessly processing and extracting useful information from multimodal sources like images. Evaluated on iNatDisco, a new multimodal ecological knowledge benchmark with pattern-level ground truth obtained from peer-reviewed literature, DiscoPER recovers 8 of 9 known patterns with a 72.7% hypothesis support rate, outperforming both classical causal discovery and LLM-guided baselines. Ablations show that DiscoPER scales with more data, and confirms the benefits of second-order meta-reflection.
2607.01131.paper_summary_zh: 自主科學發現系統提供了通過自動化假設生成和驗證過程來加速研究的潛力。<lb/>然而，當前的系統運作在受限的搜尋空間內或需要預先定義的研究問題，限制了它們進行真正開放式探究的能力。<lb/>此外，儘管它們以迭代方式生成假設，但在明確綜合自身累積的發現以揭示複雜的相互關聯現象方面，仍然大多缺乏能力。<lb/>我們介紹了DiscoPER，一個由大型語言模型驅動的自主框架，通過動態生成和執行代碼來探索數據集，進行開放式研究，而不需要預先指定的研究目標。<lb/>為了確保嚴謹的科學有效性，每一項提議的發現必須通過統計測試。<lb/>為了克服孤立搜尋的限制，我們的框架引入了一個二階推理機制，定期分析其自身累積的發現。<lb/>通過將先前的發現視為實證數據，DiscoPER識別結構模式、混淆因素和認識上的空白，主動將假設探索重新導向到搜尋空間中未被探索的區域。<lb/>通過整合工具使用，搜尋空間進一步擴展，使系統能夠超越結構化元數據探索假設，無縫處理和提取來自多模態來源（如圖像）的有用信息。<lb/>在iNatDisco上進行評估，這是一個新的多模態生態知識基準，其模式級別的真實數據來自於同行評審文獻，DiscoPER以72.7%的假設支持率恢復了9個已知模式中的8個，超越了傳統的因果發現和LLM指導的基準。<lb/>消融實驗顯示，DiscoPER隨著數據的增加而擴展，並確認了二階元反思的好處。
